**Answer: No.** The Northgate Business Park Lease Abstract does not include any right of first refusal (or right of first offer/purchase option) for the tenant to purchase the property. The abstract's sections cover Premises, Term (10-year initial term, April 2025–March 2035), Rent Schedule ($34.50/SF base rent with 3% annual escalations), Operating Expenses & Reimbursements (triple-net with a 5% controllable-expense cap), Renewal Options (two 5-year options at 95% FMR), and Tenant Covenants (continuous-operation requirement for anchor tenant Vantage Fulfillment Co.) — none of which reference a right of first refusal, right of first offer, or any tenant option to purchase the property.
